title: Terms of use — Klarineo
description: Terms of use for the Klarineo app: what the service does, limits of AI explanations, subscriptions via App Store and Google Play, acceptable use and liability.
h1: Terms of use for the Klarineo app
intro: These terms of use govern your use of the Klarineo mobile app (the “App”) provided by TIYN ZAYTUN LLC (“we”, “us”). By using the App you agree to these terms. Please also read our privacy policy.

p: Klarineo helps you understand everyday German letters and learn practical German. You can photograph a letter or enter text, receive an explanation in your chosen language (what the letter is, who sent it, what you may need to do and possible deadlines), key German phrases and a draft reply. The App also offers deadline reminders, spaced-repetition review of phrases, AI role-play speaking practice and a daily goal.
We may develop, change or discontinue features. Some features are only available with a Klarineo Pro subscription.

Explanations, translations, deadlines, phrases and reply drafts are generated automatically by artificial intelligence. They can be incomplete, outdated or wrong — for example a date or amount may be misread.

Always check the original letter, in particular names, amounts, dates and deadlines. Deadlines in German letters often depend on the date of delivery, which the App cannot know. A reminder in the App does not replace your own check of the deadline. You are responsible for any reply you send; check drafts before using them.

Klarineo provides general information and language help. It is not legal, tax, immigration, medical or financial advice and does not replace a lawyer, tax adviser, a counselling service such as the Migrationsberatung für erwachsene Zuwanderer (MBE), or the authority that sent the letter. For important or urgent matters, contact the sender or a qualified adviser.
Klarineo is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or acting on behalf of any German authority, insurer or company.

sections.h: 4. Free plan, Klarineo Pro and free trial
p: The App can be used with a free plan with limited features. Klarineo Pro is an optional paid subscription, purchased through the Apple App Store or Google Play. The price, billing period and currency are shown in the store before you buy and may differ by country.

Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (or as otherwise stated by the store). You can manage and cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. Uninstalling the App does not cancel a subscription.

New subscribers may be offered a 7-day free trial. Unless you cancel before the trial ends, it converts into a paid subscription. The exact trial conditions, eligibility and timing are shown in the store and governed by the store's terms.
Payments, refunds and statutory withdrawal rights are handled by Apple or Google according to their terms. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.
